correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated the full 4^8 outgoing-choice space with indegree and directed-cycle constraints and obtained exactly 6497 augmented faces with by-cardinality counts (1,24,216,928,2016,2160,1008,144) and independently computed canonical face-set SHA256 9115bf451a1470e640cb1d07f243f5c9f16cf7e1276d1c5a9034acc5e9a6a102. Reconstructed 3199 ordered-arc matching pairs and globally verified acyclicity over all 29160 augmented covering incidences. Independently computed signed integer Morse differential for all adjacent critical dimensions; all 99 critical cell boundaries vanish identically, giving precisely four free integral homology groups without torsion. The augmented empty face is matched; ordinary Morse CW has one vertex and no one-/two-cells, hence 2-connected; Hurewicz gives π3=H3=Z6. Higher attaching maps and wedge decomposition were not determined, correctly excluded from claim.

originality.rationale: Caputi–Collari–Di Trani–Smith arXiv:2208.04656 full PDF inspected; its homotopy classifications concern directed linear graphs, polygons, small coherently oriented grids and transitive tournaments, not the fully bidirected degree-three cube. A comparison theorem via graph minors/matching complexes in arXiv:2401.01248 assumes no oriented cycles, but this bidirected Q3 contains directed 2-cycles along every undirected edge. Later bidirectional polygonal digraphs (arXiv:2601.05670) are degree-two graphs rather than the cube. Ordinary cube discrete Morse complexes are different simplicial complexes.
